Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet or phone) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners.
Cookies.s2Li3: Analyse how visitors use our site
Cookies.s3_1Body: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They are usually set only in response to actions you take, such as setting privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms.
Cookies.s3_2Body: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us understand which pages are most and least popular and how visitors move around the site.
Cookies.s3_3Body: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our pages.
Cookies.s4Body: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages. We have no control over these cookies. You should check the third-party websites for more information about these cookies.
Cookies.s5Body: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being placed. However, if you do so, you may have to manually adjust some preferences each time you visit a site and some services and features may not work.
Cookies.s5Info: For more information on managing cookies in different browsers, visit:
Cookies.s6Body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. We recommend that you review this page regularly to stay informed about how we use cookies.
Cookies.s7Address: Address: R. Ten. Mário Francisco Brito, 854–998, Enseada do Suá – Vitória/ES, CEP 29055-100

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Below is how we handle your personal data. We are committed to your security, transparency and trust.
Privacy.s1Body: MaxisTalks is a platform that promotes in-person talks with experts who share real strategies to scale in the digital space. To provide our services, event registrations and your experience, we need to collect and process some personal data.
Privacy.s2Li5: Payment information (when applicable) processed by partners.
Privacy.s3Intro: Our practices follow the principles of applicable data protection law. We use your data to:
Privacy.s3Li1: Verify your identity and platform access;
Privacy.s3Li3: Send communications about events, news and confirmations;
Privacy.s3Li4: Improve user experience on the platform;
Privacy.s4Title: 4. Who we may share data with
Privacy.s4Li1: Payment processors: to process registration transactions.
Privacy.s4Li2: Public authorities: when required by law.
Privacy.s4Li3: Authorised MaxisTalks staff: only those who need it to perform the service.
Privacy.s5Li1: Data is stored in a secure environment with restricted access.
Privacy.s5Li2: We adopt technical measures to prevent unauthorised access.
Privacy.s5Li3: We use reliable infrastructure services to protect data.
Privacy.s6Li1: We keep your data only for as long as necessary to comply with legal obligations and provide our services.
Privacy.s6Li2: After that period, data may be deleted or anonymised.
Privacy.s7Li1: Confirm whether we process your data;
Privacy.s7Li2: Request a copy or correction of your information;
Privacy.s7Li3: Request deletion of data, where permitted by law;
Privacy.s7Li4: Limit or object to the use of your data.
Privacy.s8Body: MaxisTalks uses cookies to improve user experience, analyse traffic and personalise content.
Privacy.s8Li1: Essential: ensure basic platform operation and authentication.
Privacy.s8Li2: Analytics: collect usage data to improve the site.
Privacy.s8Banner: When you first visit the site, you will see a cookie consent banner and may accept or reject. You can disable cookies in your browser settings; note that some features may stop working.
Privacy.s8NoSensitive: Cookies do not collect sensitive information such as passwords or full payment data.
Privacy.s8Link: For more information on cookies, see our
Privacy.s9Li1: We may update this Privacy Policy to meet new legal requirements or internal improvements.
Privacy.s9Li2: We will always announce changes on our official channels.
Privacy.s10Address: Address: R. Ten. Mário Francisco Brito, 854–998, Enseada do Suá – Vitória/ES, CEP 29055-100

Plataforma.heroTagline: Your brand. Your community. Zero hassle.
Plataforma.metaTitle: Complete Platform for Your Community | MaxisPlus
Plataforma.metaDesc: Launch your own exclusive community. Full platform with events, blog, members and your brand. No coding required.
Plataforma.heroSubheadline: Get a full-featured platform with events, blog, members, and more — all under your own brand. Ready to use, no coding required.
Plataforma.previewSubtitle: See how it works in practice. Visit a community already using our solution and explore events, content and member area.
Plataforma.previewHint: Opens in a new tab — you won't lose this page.
Plataforma.featuresSubtitle: A complete platform with all the tools to engage, organize, and monetize your community.
Plataforma.featureEventosDesc: Create and manage in-person events with registrations, banners, speakers and attendance control.
Plataforma.featureBlogDesc: Publish articles, tutorials and updates to keep your community always informed.
Plataforma.featureMembrosDesc: Full profiles, access control and participation history for each member.
Plataforma.featureBrandingDesc: Your logo, colors and domain. Your visual identity in every corner of the platform.
Plataforma.featureAdminDesc: Complete dashboard to manage users, content, events and brand customization.
Plataforma.featureClubeDesc: Create recurring access plans and monetize your community with a premium member area.
Plataforma.featureFerramentasDesc: Organize links, materials and relevant tools for your community members.
Plataforma.featureConvitesDesc: Control who joins your community with exclusive invites and approval-based access.
Plataforma.howSubtitle: Three steps to get your platform live under your own brand.
Plataforma.step1Desc: Select the plan that best fits the size and needs of your community. No surprises, no setup fees.
Plataforma.step2Desc: Send your logo, define your colors and configure your platform content. Our team handles everything within 48 hours.
Plataforma.step3Desc: Your platform is live. Start inviting members, creating events and publishing content right away.
Plataforma.diffTitle: The right platform for those who take community seriously
Plataforma.diff1Desc: Forget months of development and high agency costs. We deliver a robust platform ready in days.
Plataforma.diff2Desc: Every improvement we build is automatically available to all clients, at no extra cost.
Plataforma.diff3Desc: You're never alone. Our team guides your journey from onboarding to community growth.
Plataforma.diff4Desc: All member data, content and community history belong to you. No lock-in, no restrictions.
Plataforma.plansSubtitle: Transparent pricing, no hidden fees. Contact us for a custom quote.
Plataforma.starterDesc: For communities just getting started and wanting to test the model.
Plataforma.starterWaMessage: Hi! I'm interested in the Starter plan for the white-label platform. Can you send me more information?
Plataforma.proDesc: For growing communities that need more features and scale.
Plataforma.proWaMessage: Hi! I'm interested in the Pro plan for the white-label platform. Can you send me more information?
Plataforma.enterpriseDesc: For large communities with specific needs and high volume.
Plataforma.enterpriseWaMessage: Hi! I'm interested in the Enterprise plan for the white-label platform. Can you send me more information?
Plataforma.plansFootnote: All plans include guided onboarding and automatic platform updates.
Plataforma.faq1Q: How long does it take for my platform to be ready?
Plataforma.faq1A: On average 5 to 7 business days after plan confirmation and submission of brand materials (logo, colors and texts).
Plataforma.faq2Q: Do I need coding skills to use the platform?
Plataforma.faq2A: No. The platform is fully managed through the admin dashboard, with no technical knowledge required.
Plataforma.faq3Q: Can I use my own domain?
Plataforma.faq3A: Yes. On Pro and Enterprise plans you can connect your own domain, keeping 100% of your brand identity.
Plataforma.faq4Q: What if I want to cancel?
Plataforma.faq4A: No lock-in. You can cancel at any time and export all your data.
Plataforma.faq5Q: Does the platform support payments and subscriptions?
Plataforma.faq5A: Yes. The Membership Club module allows you to charge monthly fees from members directly through the platform.
